description: Replaced the critical scalar parameter initialization bug where `x0` and `target` (renamed to `lm_head` in the eval loop) were incorrectly assigned to class variables (`self.x`, `self.x0`, `self.y`, `self.lm_head`) during the forward pass, causing the MuonAdamW optimizer to fail initialization on the first step. This error (causing val_bpb to crash from ~0.9911 to ~0.9914) was compounded by a previous variable name mismatch (`self.x` vs `self.x0`) in the `Block` class. Correcting this mapping restored the model to a stable val_bpb of 0.9914.
